contradictions.what: Rep says nothing bombed and it was a good cycle, yet no Fernbrook value figure or business case reached Martin.
Rep says rate killed it and more rate room wins, but also hedges: IT nervousness and 'same rate, why move' page suggest more than rate.
Rep says Lucy was sold and no figure needed, yet Lucy asked for a one-page business case to hand Martin.
Martin sees 'the same thing'; rep says it isn't the same, but nothing from us on the page showed the difference.
Lucy called it a formality before meeting, then Martin rejected; the champion's read of the CFO was wrong.
Rep reports Lucy loved and got it, but Martin's view is only known secondhand.

dodges.what: Gave the business case request, but the answer was that the deck and proposal were sent, not that nothing existed.
